purpose: Decide quickly and fairly whether a student organization may hold an event, using the rules of the campus and facts from the campus systems and free public APIs.

rules.BR-01: An event cannot be approved on a public holiday.
rules.BR-02: An outdoor event needs a rain chance below 60 percent on its date.
rules.BR-03: The venue must be free at the requested time and hold at least as many people as the attendees.
rules.BR-04: A venue with an unpaid facility penalty cannot be reserved.
rules.BR-05: The deposit must be paid before approval.
rules.BR-06: Every request names a title, a date, a venue, the number of attendees and a budget.
rules.BR-07: Money in another currency is converted to Philippine pesos at the latest rate.
rules.BR-08: A request is approved only when every check passed.

exceptions: The form is incomplete: show the missing fields and keep what was typed.

outputs: holiday check: ok, or the name of the holiday
exceptions: The service does not answer: mark the check unknown and ask the officer to decide.

outputs: venue check: free or not, capacity, unpaid penalty
exceptions: The venue does not exist: return a clear error to the organizer.

outputs: weather check: rain chance in percent, or not needed for indoor events
exceptions: The date is too far ahead for a forecast: mark the check unknown.

outputs: budget check: deposit paid or not, budget in pesos
exceptions: The exchange rate is not available: use the last known rate and say so.
The officer disagrees with the checks: the request is returned with a written reason.
The e-mail cannot be sent: try again later, then record the failure.

G3.question: All checks passed?
G3.no: at least one check failed or is unknown
